name: Capture
description:
You throw one of your empty vessels at a non-humanoid creature within medium range. Roll Awe, Spirit, or Persuade and add the vessel's keeping to the result. If the creature’s current Endurance is less than half its base, the roll is favored.

  • On a result equal to or greater than the creature's Challenge score, the creature is captured within the vessel.

  • On a result below the creature’s Challenge score, the vessel bursts and cannot be used again.

When you capture a creature, also apply the following based on the skill you used:

  • Awe. Mark BODY; the creature gains 1 Friendship.

  • Spirit. Mark HEART; the creature gains 2 Friendship.

  • Persuade. Mark WITS; the creature gains 3 Friendship.

The marked core ability costs double the normal amount of XP to increase for that creature.

Describe how you attempt to capture the creature.
successes:
✨: Add 1 to your roll result.

🌞: Add the vessel's keeping to your roll result twice.

💀: If you capture the creature, it has 0 levels of friendship. If you do not capture the creature, its attack rolls against you are favored for the next round.
